items.statement: Each reported transition state is validated as a saddle point for its assigned bond-making or bond-breaking event.
items.expected: Minima have no imaginary frequencies; each transition state has one relevant imaginary frequency and its displacement corresponds to C–H oxidative addition or C–B reductive elimination as labeled.

items.statement: Free energies use consistent electronic, thermal, solvation and concentration conventions.
items.expected: The report states a common reference and accounts for electronic energy, ZPE, entropy at reaction temperature, THF solvation and the solvent-as-substrate concentration treatment.

items.statement: The α C–H oxidative-addition activation free energy is reproduced.
The β C–H oxidative-addition activation free energy is reproduced.
The α C–B reductive-elimination transition-state free energy is reproduced.
The β C–B reductive-elimination transition-state free energy is reproduced.
